original_card.question: Can one measured replay bottleneck be sped up without dropping coverage?
methods: Profile one isolated replay and optimize the measured bottleneck.
Design source-bound reuse with explicit dependency invalidation and negative controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Report before/after wall time on the same fixture, retained checks and invalidation behavior.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected reproduction command and choose a single replay stage for profiling.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Measure one unchanged fixture, preserve check coverage, and test one optimization with invalidation controls.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Faster trustworthy replays increase review throughput and let mechanism candidates be checked sooner.
allowed_variations: Profile one stage or design one source-bound cache boundary.
scope_change_triggers: Skipping coverage or comparing different fixtures to claim speedup.

actual_scope: Can the production affine-vector Leech-minor checker (scripts/experiments/affine_vector_screens.py:leech_minor, exercised by scripts/audit_affine_vectors.py / certificates/affine-vector-screens.json) adopt the exact base-256 byte-lane row construction from research/leech-minor-byte-lanes/ so the shipped verify-certificates path is faster while every matrix entry, row digest, binary rank and admission flag stays identical?
scope_change_reason: The catalogue card asks for one measured replay bottleneck with before/after wall time and retained checks. Expertise override selected verifier-engineering after profiling make verify-certificates poles. Leave-alone objects (joint frames, shared-point, mixed-point verify, ternary frames, parity-side, DisjointTensor.frame_data, production verify_factor) and deferred micro-opts were not reopened. Jerry Chen's incorporated #898 already proved an opt-in identical-receipt accelerator; production still used the historical pairwise sparse-dot genexpr.
bottleneck_link: Side result on review throughput: affine-vector screens are part of verify-certificates. Faster identical Leech-minor rows do not change kappa or the binding complex supplier.
ai_assistance: Substantial AI assistance for orientation, overlap search, profiling, production wiring, packaging, benchmarking and writing
evidence: PASS_LEECH_MINOR_PRODUCTION via research/leech-minor-production/verify.py (also under -O); PASS_IDENTICAL_LEECH_MINOR_PRODUCTION_RECEIPTS via benchmark.py; certificates/affine-vector-screens.json differs from base only in the affine_vector_screens.py source pin.
author: Wentao Li
stop_rule: Ship an equivalence-preserving production leech_minor change with frozen baseline, identical Leech and full-audit payloads, rejection/temp-corruption controls, certificate pin discipline, registered replay and a measured before/after median. Do not invent kappa or reopen leave-alone objects.
